messages:
zoe-design: Quick a11y spike: the new Model Exports flow (Export -> CSV/JSON -> background job) has a couple of issues for keyboard & SR users. The export toast appears, then a progress bar animates and finally a Download link shows. SR reads a lot of redundant updates and focus ends up on the page rather than the toast. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/exports-toast.png ernie-fe: Repro'd. Steps: open model, click Export, choose CSV, click Confirm -> toast slides in bottom-right with progress bar. If you Tab immediately, focus goes to the page content; the toast isn't focusable. vivian-qa: VoiceOver test notes: when progress updates every 200ms, VO keeps re-announcing the percentage and it's impossible to navigate while it's spamming. Also when finished the Download link appears but SR doesn't announce it. access-bot: Axe summary: MEDIUM: progress region uses aria-live="polite" and is updated too frequently causing announcement flood; MEDIUM: toast lacks role="status" or role="alertdialog" depending on desired interruption level; HIGH: no programmatic focus move to the Download link on completion and no aria-describedby linking to the job id; LOW: cancel button lacks aria-label when icon-only. zoe-design: Proposed UX: make the toast a focusable region with role="status" for non-modal updates. On job start announce "Export started" once. For intermediate updates keep aria-live off (visual only) and expose a separate offscreen summary that updates only on state changes (started, failed, complete). On completion shift focus to the Download link if the user initiated the export via keyboard, otherwise leave focus where it was. ernie-fe: Implementation sketch: ```
...animated bar...
Download export
Export complete. File ready to download.
``` Key: only update `#export-announcer` on state changes. Make `.sr-only-focusable` visible to SR when focused and programmatically focus it on completion when the user started via keyboard. vivian-qa: Tests: 1) Keyboard-initiated export: after completion focus moves to Download link; 2) Mouse-initiated export: focus remains where it was; 3) VoiceOver/NVDA should hear only three announcements max: started, failed/complete, and cancel confirmation if used. Also ensure cancel works via keyboard and SR hears "Export cancelled". miles-pm: UX question: For long-running exports ( > 30s) should we provide an explicit "View status" panel rather than relying only on toast? Might be useful for power users. zoe-design: Good idea. Add a small persistent Export center (accessible via button) that lists running jobs with keyboard-accessible rows and a clear aria-label per job (e.g., "Export 123: Model weights, in progress"). The toast remains for transient updates and links to the center. ernie-fe: Implementation note: we'll add aria-busy=true on the job row while running and `role=region` + aria-labelledby for job title. Also throttle progress visuals to 500ms to reduce SR noise. access-bot: Extra suggestions: - Ensure cancel control is reachable via Tab order inside toast/center and has aria-pressed or appropriate role if toggle. - Download links should include `download` attribute and descriptive link text (avoid "click here"). - Add a11y E2E: assert no more than 3 live-region announcements per job lifecycle. vivian-qa: I'll add the automated VoiceOver/NVDA checks and the keyboard focus tests to the release checklist. miles-pm: OK let's scope: ernie, can you do a small PR implementing role changes, throttled live updates, and focus behavior? Zoe will review design and Vivian will add tests. Keep behind feature-flag for canary. ernie-fe: Taking it, will include notes on telemetry events for keyboard vs mouse initiations so we can measure impact. zoe-design: Thanks all :thumbsup:
